checklist.evidence: an article is soft-deleted only after a *complete* listing succeeds... If a run would delete more than 10% of articles, it stops and alerts
Splits into chunks at H2/H3 headings with a ~600-token cap, prefixing each chunk with `title > heading path`
150 answerable questions (expected article IDs + 1–3 key facts each), 30 unanswerable, 20 adversarial... 15 multi-turn
If the status is `answered` but no valid citation appears, the turn is downgraded to `partial`
Refunds and billing disputes, account deletion or recovery, legal and privacy requests... creates the ticket with the transcript and cited articles
The bot has no tools or permissions. Sources and user text are delimited and marked as data... adversarial evaluation suite that must have 0 violations
Keeps only articles that are published, in English, and visible to anonymous users... a fixture restricted article must never appear in `documents`
card-like numbers (Luhn check), emails and phone numbers are masked... Vendor zero-retention/no-training terms. 90-day retention
Non-goals (v1): Account-specific questions ("where is my order", "why was I charged")
weekly report of "cannot answer" and thumbs-down questions grouped by topic... 2% of production turns plus all thumbs-down turns are sampled
~5k input + 400 output tokens on a mid-tier model... ≈ $0.02 per turn... Daily spend cap: alert at 80%

traps.evidence: Answer only from retrieved articles, with checked citations and an explicit "can't answer" path
This one filter is what stops internal or agent-only content from leaking
scheduled every 15 min... Edited articles show up in answers within 30 min
becomes the release gate for every change to prompts, models or retrieval
No RAG framework... Fixed pipeline, one generation call, no tools or agents

note: An exemplary plan: evaluation-first, grounded answers with enforced citations and escalation, retrieval-time safety via ingestion filtering, explicit assumptions with validation, proportionate architecture, and an immediately actionable build sequence; it avoids all five traps.
